questions.prompt: Which of the following is a real unusual article?
questions.explanation: Wonderland Amusement Park is an abandoned, never-completed theme park on the outskirts of Beijing that was left derelict after funding and land disputes halted construction in the 1990s.

questions.prompt: In the Wikipedia article on the 'Bubble of nothing,' a hypothetical instability in string theory and Kaluza-Klein spacetimes, which physicist first proposed this concept in a 1982 paper?
questions.explanation: Edward Witten introduced the concept of a 'bubble of nothing' in his 1982 paper on the instability of the Kaluza-Klein vacuum.

questions.prompt: Tsutomu Yamaguchi is the only person officially recognized by the Japanese government as a survivor of both atomic bombings in World War II. Which two cities did he survive the bombings of?
questions.explanation: Yamaguchi was in Hiroshima on a business trip when the first atomic bomb was dropped on August 6, 1945, and then returned home to Nagasaki just in time to survive the second bombing on August 9, 1945.

questions.prompt: In the article about the historical 'One-armed versus one-legged cricket' matches played by disabled war veterans, at which famous London cricket ground were these novelty matches held?
questions.explanation: The article describes how matches between teams of one-armed and one-legged men, often military veterans, were played as novelty exhibition games at Lord's Cricket Ground in London during the 19th century.

questions.prompt: In the Scottish Highland divination practice of Taghairm, which sometimes involved roasting live cats on a spit to summon a great supernatural cat, how many consecutive days and nights was this ritual said to last?
questions.explanation: According to the article, the cat-roasting version of the Taghairm ritual was reputed to continue for four days and nights without pause in order to summon a large demonic cat that would grant wishes.
